import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re

B = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HEAD = '34dc4e14dc96d077eae6173ab6885370323eff3f'
MERGE = 'dc45064b0bdcbc25f03fb09d9e276f30d7694939'
TREE = '74233d3b797162da63547afa04df2358acffe320'
P = '58a890857a6b6c2da874491817beb6d561897a9a'
R = 'b39fdd8c858755d1a92c176efc5340907f4a3757'

def desc(p):
    z = p.read_bytes()
    return dict(path=p.name, bytes=len(z), sha256=hashlib.sha256(z).hexdigest(),
                git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(z)).encode()+b'\0'+z).hexdigest())

raw = (B/'check.original-decoded.log').read_bytes()
assert len(raw) == 1083987
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '914ed9521e6c95d344a488ad0c72df532f6a218c41370db42bea75b8110c73d5'
lines = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', raw.decode('utf-8-sig')).splitlines()
merge = json.loads((B/'merge-commit.json').read_text())
assert merge['sha'] == MERGE and merge['tree']['sha'] == TREE
assert [x['sha'] for x in merge['parents']] == ['23eab8a7ea1fdfd6333c2e5a001cfb41e2a10d69', HEAD]
assert any(x.endswith(MERGE) for x in lines)
assert any('[command]/usr/bin/git sparse-checkout disable' in x for x in lines)
assert any('Updating files: 100% (24214/24214), done.' in x for x in lines)
jobs = json.loads((B/'main-jobs-terminal.json').read_text())['jobs']
assert {x['id'] for x in jobs} == {113995970124,113995970455,113995970531}
assert all(x['status']=='completed' and x['conclusion']=='success' for x in jobs)
check = next(x for x in jobs if x['id']==113995970455)
assert all(s['status']=='completed' and s['conclusion']=='success' for s in check['steps'])

invocations = []
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'Running tests/p8_scale.rs (' not in line:
        continue
    end = next(j for j in range(i+1,len(lines)) if 'test result: ' in lines[j])
    names = [re.search(r'test (.+) \.\.\. ok$', x).group(1) for x in lines[i+1:end] if re.search(r'test (.+) \.\.\. ok$', x)]
    m = re.search(r'(\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out', lines[end])
    assert m
    counts = dict(zip(['passed','failed','ignored','measured','filtered'],map(int,m.groups())))
    assert len(names)==counts['passed']
    invocations.append(dict(start_line=i+1,end_line=end+1,start=lines[i],result=lines[end],counts=counts,passed_methods=names))
assert len(invocations)==3
assert [x['counts']['passed'] for x in invocations]==[16,0,16]
assert invocations[0]['passed_methods']==invocations[2]['passed_methods'] or set(invocations[0]['passed_methods'])==set(invocations[2]['passed_methods'])
assert invocations[1]['counts']['filtered']==16
assert all(x['counts']['failed']==x['counts']['ignored']==0 for x in invocations)
proofs = []
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if '{"schema_version": 10, "source_version": "p8-completion-source-20261009-v15"' in line:
        obj = json.loads(line[line.index('{'):])
        assert obj['status']=='passed' and obj['complete_inputs']==1095
        assert obj['product_source']==P and obj['review_source']==R
        assert obj['executed_previous_proof']=='p8-oracle-compat-source-20261008-v14'
        proofs.append(dict(line=i+1,timestamp=line.split(' ',1)[0],output=obj))
assert len(proofs)==1
lib = (B/'benchmark-lib.rs').read_bytes()
canonical_path = B.parent/'round25-GCW3-binding/inputs/canonical.json'
canonical = json.loads(canonical_path.read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(lib).hexdigest()==canonical['complete_inputs']['crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs']
assert b'tb.warm_p95_us < 500_000,' in lib
fixture_paths = [p for p in canonical['complete_inputs'] if p.startswith('crates/cc-eval/fixtures/sample-project/')]
corpus_paths = [p for p in canonical['complete_inputs'] if p.startswith('crates/cc-eval/corpus/')]
assert fixture_paths and corpus_paths
fixture_ok = [dict(line=i+1,original=x) for i,x in enumerate(lines) if 'test tests::benchmark_fixture ... ok' in x]
assert len(fixture_ok)==2
selected_names = [
 'project_model::acknowledgement_tests::borrowed_acknowledgement_matches_owned_bytes_and_recaptured_inputs',
 'invalid_frontier_precedes_a_file_mutation_error',
 'prepared_frontier_keeps_legacy_bytes_and_late_failure_rolls_back_facts',
 'equal_sequence_witness_still_checks_the_second_input_budget_and_first_error',
 'input_witness_keeps_distinct_sql_types_and_column_layouts_on_the_original_path',
]
selected = {n:[dict(line=i+1,original=x) for i,x in enumerate(lines) if f'test {n} ... ok' in x] for n in selected_names}
assert all(selected.values())
report = dict(schema_version=1, verdict='accepted_for_original_main_CI_execution_evidence',
 source=dict(pr=195,head=HEAD,actual_checkout=MERGE,actual_checkout_kind='pull_request_merge',
             exact_full_tree=TREE,product=P,review=R,entire_merge_tree_equals_head=True),
 workflow=dict(run_id=37982419396,attempt=1,check_job_id=113995970455,
               jobs=[dict(id=x['id'],name=x['name'],status=x['status'],conclusion=x['conclusion']) for x in jobs],
               original_check_steps=check['steps']),
 toolchain='rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)',
 original_log=desc(B/'check.original-decoded.log'),
 v15=proofs[0], scale_protocol=dict(unique_passed_methods=16,invocations=invocations,
              repeated_optional_http_invocation_is_not_16_additional_unique_tests=True),
 fixture=dict(test_reports=fixture_ok,source=desc(B/'benchmark-lib.rs'),
              original_assertion='tb.warm_p95_us < 500_000',
              tracked_fixture_leaf_count=len(fixture_paths),tracked_corpus_leaf_count=len(corpus_paths),
              existence_evidence='Full checkout explicitly disables sparse checkout and completes all 24214 paths; both directories have tracked canonical inputs.',
              per_tool_p95_values=None,per_tool_p95_unavailable_reason='Successful test captured stdout; no numeric benchmark table in original log.'),
 selected_payload_oracle_controls=selected,
 acceptance_limits=['This proves this main CI execution only; other PR checks retain their own current states.',
                    'Official step success and actual test/v15 stdout are retained; no separately captured per-command integer exit receipt is invented.',
                    'Cached CI engineering execution is not a cold benchmark or a primary scale sample.',
                    'Original prior failures remain; no scale/TODO conclusion is inferred.'],
 todo=dict(newly_done=0,remaining=29),
 reviewer_execution=dict(kind='read_only_parser_over_original_logs_and_source',no_workload_or_source_CLI_rerun=True))
with (B/'independent-terminal-review.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(report,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed',report=desc(B/'independent-terminal-review.json'),unique_scale_methods=16),sort_keys=True))
